text:
Noah - Growth: Quick ask for the launch webinar deck: can eng/runtime run a small AB sweep so we can claim quantized customer-facing numbers that are reproducible? Need heatmap, tail percentiles, cost per 1k tokens, and an AB delta between q4 and q8 + fp16 baseline. Target model: redwood-7b-q4 and redwood-7b-q8, baseline redwood-7b-fp16. Region: us-central1.

Kai (Eng Runtime): Sounds fine. A few clarifying Qs: run length? QPS profile? do you want caching on for any arm? what about an eval suite to check quality drift?

Noah - Growth: Keep it compact: 30 QPS sustained for 8 minutes each arm, 60s ramp, and a cold probe (30s zero) every 90s. Turn caching off for q4 to show worst-case; enable prefix cache for fp16 and q8 by default. Eval suite: yes, use "webinar-eval-200" (Priya will provide). Also tag outputs as "webinar-ready" so we can link artifacts. Include time-to-first-token and TTFB histogram buckets (0-50ms,50-100ms,...).

Priya (Data Science): I'll drop the eval pack in the shared drive: webinar-eval-200.json. We'll run embedding cosine and a token-divergence metric; flag any >2.5% embedding drop. Also include 200 pairwise human-check prompts for the demo.

Kai (Eng Runtime): Noted. We'll run three arms: q4 (no-cache), q8 (cache on), fp16 (cache on). We'll collect median/p50, p90, p95, p99 latencies, coldstart heatmap with 10s buckets, cost-per-1k-tokens, and export raw traces. Example payload snippet to include in blog link (we'll ingest full marketing-webinar-payloads-v2.json):

```
[
  {"id":"w1","prompt":"Describe Redwood Inference in one short line.","max_tokens":40},
  {"id":"w2","prompt":"Bullet 4 ways to cut LLM serving cost for enterprise.","max_tokens":120},
  {"id":"w3-long","prompt":"<context 5000 tokens> Explain a warmup strategy for hybrid batching and caching.","max_tokens":300}
]
```

Sandeep (Eng Infra): FYI infra note: q4 runtime images currently live on our p3d pool in us-central only; q8+fp16 run on a100 pool. If both pools are busy, we may stagger starts or fallback to fp16 for the q4 arm. We'll log any fallbacks to the artifact.

bench-bot: Jobs queued: job_ids=webinar-ab-3476-q4,webinar-ab-3476-q8,webinar-ab-3476-fp16. ETA ~1.5h. Artifacts: https://internal-artifacts/redwood/webinar-ab-3476. Notifying #eng-runtime and #marketing :robot_face:

Lila (Product Marketing): Timeline ask: can we get a one-line headline + top-line percentiles within 12 hours of run start? Marketing needs to lock webinar slides. Full artifacts + eval summary in 36 hours would be ideal.

Kai (Eng Runtime): If the jobs start within the hour we can do preliminary headline + percentiles in ~12 hours, full artifact bundle + eval in ~306 hours. We'll also include a short markdown comparing q4 vs q8 vs fp16 (latency, cost, embedding-sim). Say :thumbsup: and we'll lock the schedule.

Noah - Growth: :thumbsup: Lock it. Two notes: 1) please ensure reproducible seeds are recorded and the payload bundle is the exact file marketing-webinar-payloads-v2.json from the shared drive; 2) call out if any quality regression >2.5% on Priya's eval set as "needs review" and don't include that claim in the headline. Thanks team.
